def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Horizontal and vertical separator lines are the repeated solid bands.
    base = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),
               key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == base for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == base for r in range(h))]

    # Separator intervals define the marker lattice. Sample the interior
    # separator crossings, replacing unmarked background crossings by the
    # dominant color in the tile interiors.
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[base]]
    row_step = rows[1] - rows[0]
    col_step = cols[1] - cols[0]
    rs = list(range(rows[0] + row_step, h, row_step))
    cs = list(range(cols[0] + col_step, w, col_step))

    interior_counts = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != base:
                interior_counts[grid[r][c]] = interior_counts.get(grid[r][c], 0) + 1
    fill = max(interior_counts, key=interior_counts.get) if interior_counts else base

    out = []
    for r in rs:
        row = []
        for c in cs:
            v = grid[r][c]
            row.append(fill if v == base else v)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The special colors lie on the horizontal/vertical separator lattice.
    # Infer lattice lines from the full-width/full-height background bands.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == bg for x in grid[r]) >= w - 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h)) >= h - 2]

    def stride(ix):
        ds = [b - a for a, b in zip(ix, ix[1:])]
        if not ds:
            return 1
        from collections import Counter
        return Counter(ds).most_common(1)[0][0]

    dr, dc = stride(row_lines), stride(col_lines)
    rs = list(range(row_lines[0], h, dr))
    cs = list(range(col_lines[0], w, dc))

    # Read intersection colors, then discard empty outer rows/columns and
    # repeated copies of identical adjacent marker lines.
    a = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]

    def compact(lines):
        out = []
        for line in lines:
            if not out or line != out[-1]:
                out.append(line)
        return out

    a = compact(a)
    if not a:
        return [[bg]]
    cols = compact([list(col) for col in zip(*a)])
    a = [list(row) for row in zip(*cols)] if cols else a

    keep_r = [i for i, row in enumerate(a) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    if keep_r:
        a = [a[i] for i in keep_r]
    keep_c = [j for j in range(len(a[0])) if any(row[j] != bg for row in a)]
    if keep_c:
        a = [[row[j] for j in keep_c] for row in a]
    return a
